## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a public issue if relevant.

## Validation

List checks actually executed, their results, and anything unverified. Use synthetic data; do not attach credentials, private conversations, state files or raw logs.

## Compatibility and boundaries

Note changes to ACP behavior, Open WebUI projection, Buzz routing, persisted state, dependencies or supported versions. Update the relevant evidence/documentation when those boundaries change.
